authorityBasis: Project-owner direction to continue the governed physical-device campaign after the repository was deliberately made public, allowing GitHub's required-reviewer and deployment-branch protections to replace the expired private-repository plan exception.

singleOperatorConstraint.interpretation: The required-reviewer rule creates a deliberate approval event and prevents unattended secret release. It is not represented as independent two-person approval.

failClosedConditions: The approval is invalid for any build other than build 8.
The approval is invalid if the dispatch approval reference differs from BAF-REF-003-C7.
The approval is invalid if pull request 117's merge commit is not an ancestor of the dispatch commit.
The approval is invalid if the workflow actor or triggering actor is not the authorized dispatcher.
The approval is invalid if the repository is not public.
The approval is invalid if administrator bypass becomes enabled.
The approval is invalid if the required-reviewer rule, reviewer identity, self-review policy, main-only branch policy or required secret-name inventory differs.
The workflow and finalizer must observe an approved environment review for the exact GitHub run by the required reviewer.
The approval does not authorize distribution, deployment, backfill, runtime-contract activation or production data mutation.
expiresWhen: Build 8 is represented by a verified remote built tag or the governed repository/environment state differs, whichever occurs first.
